sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空中的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的后面是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七张床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝成立175周年，帮助您理解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗，来自《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: For years, even as fentanyl killed Americans at an astonishing rate,
sentences.zh: 多年来，尽管芬太尼以惊人的速度夺走美国人的生命，

sentences.en: Mexico has claimed that it was doing everything it could to crack down on its production.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥一直声称它已竭尽全力打击其生产。

sentences.en: This week, President Trump began using punishing new tariffs to test that claim.
sentences.zh: 本周，特朗普总统开始使用严厉的新关税来检验这一说法。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague, Mexico City Bureau Chief Natalie Kittrowev, on the surprising result of Trump's strategy.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事、墨西哥城分社长娜塔莉·基特罗夫将为您讲述特朗普战略令人惊讶的结果。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, March 6th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月6日，星期四。

sentences.en: It's weird being on the mic as a guest, but here we are.
sentences.zh: 作为嘉宾坐在麦克风前感觉怪怪的，但我们还是来了。

sentences.en: Um, I don't know how to address you.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不知道该怎么称呼你。

sentences.en: It's so weird.
sentences.zh: 太奇怪了。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: I was kind of wondering how you were going to handle that.
sentences.zh: 我刚才还在想你要怎么处理这个。

sentences.en: How about we just do it normal-like?
sentences.zh: 要不我们就按正常的方式来？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好。

sentences.en: Hey, Natalie.
sentences.zh: 嘿，娜塔莉。

sentences.en: Hi, Michael.
sentences.zh: 嗨，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Natalie, tell us the story, the kind of improbable story, of how you ended up inside an illegal fentanyl lab in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉，跟我们讲讲这个故事吧，一个近乎不可能的故事，关于你是如何进入墨西哥的一个非法芬太尼实验室的。

sentences.en: So, I'm the bureau chief here in Mexico City, and for a really long time now, I've been obsessed with the fentanyl problem.
sentences.zh: 我是墨西哥城的分社长，很长一段时间以来，我一直对芬太尼问题着迷。

sentences.en: Obviously, we know that in the United States, fentanyl has just been a scourge for years.
sentences.zh: 显然，我们都知道在美国，芬太尼多年来一直是个祸害。

sentences.en: It is killing tens of thousands of Americans every year, and much of the fentanyl that ends up on the street is made in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 它每年夺走成千上万美国人的生命，而流落到街头的大部分芬太尼都是在墨西哥制造的。

sentences.en: Mexico is a huge producer of fentanyl, not just in the U.S., but worldwide.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥不仅对美国，对全世界来说都是芬太尼的巨大生产国。

sentences.en: And so, I wanted to get into that manufacturing operation.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想深入了解那个制造运作过程。

sentences.en: This is a synthetic opioid.
sentences.zh: 这是一种合成阿片类药物。

sentences.en: It's not grown in fields like heroin, you know, cocaine.
sentences.zh: 它不像海洛因、可卡因那样生长在地里，你知道的。

sentences.en: These are natural drugs.
sentences.zh: 那些是天然毒品。

sentences.en: Fentanyl is made from chemicals in labs.
sentences.zh: 芬太尼是用实验室里的化学品制成的。

sentences.en: And to understand how these little pills end up in the hands of Americans every single day,
sentences.zh: 为了解这些小药丸是如何每天落入美国人手中的，

sentences.en: I found it extremely important to see, with my own eyes, exactly how it's made, step by step.
sentences.zh: 我发现亲眼目睹它是如何一步步制造出来的极其重要。

sentences.en: Right, but of course, the challenge is getting inside, I assume, the kind of places in Mexico that make fentanyl don't offer tours.
sentences.zh: 没错，但当然，挑战在于如何进去，我猜墨西哥制造芬太尼的地方可不会提供参观导览。

sentences.en: So, how did you even begin to try to get in one?
sentences.zh: 所以，你究竟是怎么开始尝试进去的？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, it wasn't easy.
sentences.zh: 对，我的意思是，这并不容易。

sentences.en: These are, as you said, illegal labs.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，这些是非法实验室。

sentences.en: This is happening underground.
sentences.zh: 这是在地下进行的。

sentences.en: This is clandestine.
sentences.zh: 这是秘密的。

sentences.en: You know, how do you break into a network that is run by cartels, by powerful organizations that are responsible for death and destruction across the country?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你如何潜入一个由贩毒集团、由在全国各地造成死亡和破坏的强大组织掌控的网络？

sentences.en: Or should I add, should you even try to make it into a separate question?
sentences.zh: 或者我应该补充，你应该把它作为一个独立的问题吗？

sentences.en: No, but, I mean, you should.
sentences.zh: 不，但是，我是说，你应该去。

sentences.en: You have to if you want to understand this thing, right?
sentences.zh: 如果你想了解这件事，你就必须去，对吧？

sentences.en: And yes, there are risks, obviously.
sentences.zh: 是的，显然存在风险。

sentences.en: But there's no way to really get inside this business without seeing it for yourself.
sentences.zh: 但如果不亲眼看看，就真的无法深入了解这个行业。

sentences.en: And so, my colleague, Paulina Villegas, and I started making trips to Sinaloa.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的同事保利娜·比列加斯和我开始前往锡那罗亚。

sentences.en: Sinaloa is a state in the northwest of Mexico.
sentences.zh: 锡那罗亚是墨西哥西北部的一个州。

sentences.en: It is a major hub of global fentanyl production.
sentences.zh: 它是全球芬太尼生产的主要枢纽。

sentences.en: And it's the home base of one of the most dangerous and powerful criminal organizations in the world, the Sinaloa cartel.
sentences.zh: 这里是世界上最危险、最强大的犯罪组织之一——锡那罗亚贩毒集团的大本营。

sentences.en: We knew that we had to make inroads in this state in order to get into a lab because these are the guys that really dominate production, according to U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们知道我们必须在这个州打开局面才能进入实验室，因为据美国执法部门称，这些家伙真正主导了生产。

sentences.en: law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 执法部门。

sentences.en: So, we started to go there.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们开始去那里。

sentences.en: We started reporting.
sentences.zh: 我们开始进行报道。

sentences.en: We made contacts within the cartel.
sentences.zh: 我们在贩毒集团内部建立了联系。

sentences.en: We did interviews.
sentences.zh: 我们做了采访。

sentences.en: We talked to leaders.
sentences.zh: 我们与头目交谈。

sentences.en: We talked to cooks, meaning the people who actually make the fentanyl.
sentences.zh: 我们与“厨师”交谈，也就是实际制造芬太尼的人。

sentences.en: And, I mean, there were so many obstacles that kept preventing us from getting into a lab.
sentences.zh: 而且，我的意思是，有太多的障碍一直在阻碍我们进入实验室。

sentences.en: We had an inroad here.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里找到了一个切入点。

sentences.en: It was shut down.
sentences.zh: 它被关闭了。

sentences.en: An inroad there.
sentences.zh: 在那里找到了一个切入点。

sentences.en: It had just been busted.
sentences.zh: 它刚被突袭查封。

sentences.en: And then, finally, in the middle of December, we got in.
sentences.zh: 然后，终于在12月中旬，我们进去了。

sentences.en: So, tell us about that.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲那次经历吧。

sentences.en: So, the original plan was to go into this lab in the morning.
sentences.zh: 最初的计划是早上进这个实验室。

sentences.en: But there was a problem.
sentences.zh: 但出了点问题。

sentences.en: The cooks who were inviting us to see the process told us that they had just gotten busted.
sentences.zh: 邀请我们去看制作过程的“厨师”告诉我们，他们刚刚遭到突袭。

sentences.en: And so, they needed to move locations and they were going to put a makeshift lab.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们需要转移地点，并且要搭建一个临时实验室。

sentences.en: We didn't really know where at that point.
sentences.zh: 当时我们并不知道在哪里。

sentences.en: But, you know, several hours later, then into the evening, we find out that it's going to be in the center of the capital city where we are, Kulia Khan.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，几个小时后，到了晚上，我们发现它将在我们所在的首都库利亚坎市中心。

sentences.en: So, we drive to this location.
sentences.zh: 于是我们开车去了这个地方。

sentences.en: And it's a busy street.
sentences.zh: 那是一条繁忙的街道。

sentences.en: I mean, there's taco stands outside.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，外面有塔可饼摊。

sentences.en: People are walking around.
sentences.zh: 人们在四处走动。

sentences.en: It's not, you know, a deserted area in the middle of nowhere.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，它不是荒郊野岭里荒凉的地区。

sentences.en: I mean, it looked like any other house.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它看起来和其他房子没什么两样。

sentences.en: And as far as I could tell, all the people walking by had absolutely no idea that inside what looked like a normal house was an active fentanyl lab at that point.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，所有走过的人绝对都不知道，在这样一个看似普通的房子里，当时正藏着一个运转中的芬太尼实验室。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: When we go in, it's pitch black.
sentences.zh: 当我们进去时，里面漆黑一片。

sentences.en: We're going to put things that have their voices on them or photos that might identify their faces.
sentences.zh: 我们要收起那些带有他们声音或可能暴露他们面部照片的东西。

sentences.en: And we start getting suited up at this point.
sentences.zh: 这时候我们开始穿防护装备。

sentences.en: And what that means is we're putting on hazmat suits.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我们要穿上防化服。

sentences.en: We're putting on our gas masks.
sentences.zh: 我们要戴上防毒面具。

sentences.en: We put on gloves.
sentences.zh: 我们戴上手套。

sentences.en: We're preparing to come in contact with a very toxic substance.
sentences.zh: 我们正准备接触一种剧毒物质。

sentences.en: We walk down the hall with them.
sentences.zh: 我们和他们一起沿着大厅走去。

sentences.en: And then we went in.
sentences.zh: 然后我们进去了。

sentences.en: Okay, so we're in a fentanyl lab.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们现在在一个芬太尼实验室里。

sentences.en: Finally, we made it into a kitchen.
sentences.zh: 终于，我们进到了一间厨房里。

sentences.en: We're watching them cook.
sentences.zh: 我们看着他们烹制。

sentences.en: And they've just started the beginning of the process.
sentences.zh: 他们才刚开始整个过程的开头。

sentences.en: And I realize that we're in what's a really basic kitchen.
sentences.zh: 我意识到我们身处一个非常简陋的厨房里。

sentences.en: I mean, there's not a lot of advanced equipment here.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这里没有多少先进设备。

sentences.en: I'm watching the fumes come off two pots that are on a regular kitchen stove.
sentences.zh: 我看着两个放在普通厨房炉灶上的锅冒出烟雾。

sentences.en: They have two pots on the stove that, you know, are being heated with liquid.
sentences.zh: 炉子上有两个锅，你知道的，里面装着液体在加热。

sentences.en: They have trays with chemicals on them.
sentences.zh: 他们有放着化学品的托盘。

sentences.en: They have jugs with powder in them.
sentences.zh: 他们有装着粉末的罐子。

sentences.en: But apart from that, there isn't that much to it.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，也没什么特别的。

sentences.en: It looks like any other kitchen.
sentences.zh: 它看起来就像任何其他厨房一样。

sentences.en: And I saw one of the cooks just blend it all together using like a regular hand blender, black and decker that you could just buy this for.
sentences.zh: 我看到其中一个“厨师”用一个普通的黑色与德克下手持搅拌机把所有东西混合在一起，你随便就能买到这种搅拌机。

sentences.en: And the pots look like any pots that you would find in any Mexican kitchen.
sentences.zh: 那些锅看起来和你在任何墨西哥厨房里能找到的锅一模一样。

sentences.en: They have beers that they're clearly drinking while they do this.
sentences.zh: 他们在一边做这个一边显然在喝啤酒。

sentences.en: At one point, one of the cooks asks the other one for this essential chemical ingredient.
sentences.zh: 有一次，其中一个“厨师”向另一个要这种关键的化学成分。

sentences.en: And the guy turns around to the food pantry and pulls out a jug of it that's just next to hot sauce and other stuff that you might actually use to make food.
sentences.zh: 那家伙转身走到食品储藏室，掏出一罐，就放在辣酱和其他你做饭时可能会用到的东西旁边。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So right now he's adding blue to the powder mix because it's going to be pressed into those blue M30 pills.
sentences.zh: 所以现在他正在往粉末混合物里添加蓝色，因为这要被压制成那些蓝色的M30药丸。

sentences.en: And they're handling this blue powder that is close to what would be pressed into a pill.
sentences.zh: 他们在处理这种蓝色粉末，这接近于将被压制成药丸的物质。

sentences.en: And you can just see the blue seeping in.
sentences.zh: 你能看到蓝色渗入其中。

sentences.en: This is the kind of pill you see on American streets, these baby blue fentanyl pills.
sentences.zh: 这就是你在美国街头看到的这种药丸，这些浅蓝色的芬太尼药丸。

sentences.en: They start showing me like, look, we dye it blue if the client wants it blue.
sentences.zh: 他们开始向我展示，看，如果客户想要蓝色的，我们就把它染成蓝色。

sentences.en: So it was just remarkable how commonplace all of this seemed to them.
sentences.zh: 所以对他们来说，这一切看起来都如此寻常，这真是令人惊叹。

sentences.en: So when you leave this lab, what are you thinking?
sentences.zh: 那么当你离开这个实验室时，你在想什么？

sentences.en: What has this unlocked for you in your understanding of Mexico as this hub, as you said earlier, of fentanyl production?
sentences.zh: 这为你理解墨西哥作为你刚才所说的芬太尼生产枢纽带来了什么启示？

sentences.en: I think the main takeaway that I had leaving the lab was this is a drug that is extraordinarily easy to produce in almost any conditions.
sentences.zh: 我离开实验室时最大的感悟是，这是一种在几乎任何条件下都极其容易生产的毒品。

sentences.en: And once you get the product, the amount that you need to make a lot of money if you're the cartel or if you're a user to potentially kill you is tiny.
sentences.zh: 一旦你得到了产品，如果你是贩毒集团或者如果你是一个吸毒者，想要赚大钱或者潜在致死所需的数量都是微乎其微的。

sentences.en: I mean, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，美国

sentences.en: government says that people who have not been exposed to fentanyl could be killed by the amount that fits on the tip of a pencil.
sentences.zh: 政府表示，没有接触过芬太尼的人可能会被铅笔尖大小的量夺去生命。

sentences.en: And in this kitchen, in this makeshift lab, I had just seen that tip of the pencil thousands of times over.
sentences.zh: 而在间厨房里，在这个临时实验室里，我刚刚见到了成千上万个这样的铅笔尖。

sentences.en: Nellie, I guess what you're saying about the ease of production makes me wonder why it has to be done in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 内莉，我想你所说的生产简便性让我不禁好奇，为什么非得在墨西哥完成？

sentences.en: Why can't this same process occur in Texas or Brooklyn, for that matter?
sentences.zh: 为什么同样的流程不能在德克萨斯州或布鲁克林进行？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, Michael, obviously you could theoretically make fentanyl in Texas, but the conditions are not as good as they are in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 对，我的意思是，迈克尔，显然理论上你可以在德克萨斯州制造芬太尼，但那里的条件不如墨西哥好。

sentences.en: There's an entire infrastructure that really supports this.
sentences.zh: 这里有一整套真正支持这一行的基础设施。

sentences.en: The Sinaloa cartel, the cartel that is, according to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 锡那罗亚贩毒集团，据美国政府称，

sentences.en: government, responsible for bringing much of the fentanyl on American streets across the border.
sentences.zh: 该集团负责将美国街头的大部分芬太尼运过边境。

sentences.en: They have years worth of experience in industrialized drug production.
sentences.zh: 他们在工业化毒品生产方面有多年的经验。

sentences.en: They've done this with a ton of different products, including meth, which is another synthetic drug.
sentences.zh: 他们用大量不同的产品做过这种事，包括冰毒，这是另一种合成毒品。

sentences.en: So they have experience in making drugs out of chemicals.
sentences.zh: 所以他们在用化学品制造毒品方面很有经验。

sentences.en: They also have a lot of experience corrupting the Mexican government.
sentences.zh: 他们还在腐蚀墨西哥政府方面有着丰富的经验。

sentences.en: The last time there was a major crackdown on drug cartels, the security chief that led that crackdown ended up being convicted
sentences.zh: 上次对贩毒集团进行大规模打击时，领导那次打击的安全主管最终被

sentences.en: in an American court for taking bribes from the Sinaloa cartel.
sentences.zh: 美国法庭裁定罪名成立，罪名是接受锡那罗亚贩毒集团的贿赂。

sentences.en: So this is an incredibly powerful, experienced organization that has the wherewithal and the resources to do this.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个极其强大、经验丰富的组织，拥有这样做的实力和资源。

sentences.en: And the Mexican government has not been effective at stamping that out.
sentences.zh: 而墨西哥政府在铲除这一势力方面一直没有成效。

sentences.en: So a key ingredient here that explains why Mexico is the Mexican government's inability slash unwillingness to truly take on and crack down on these cartels.
sentences.zh: 所以这里解释为什么墨西哥是枢纽的一个关键因素是墨西哥政府无力斜杠不愿真正迎头痛击并打击这些贩毒集团。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, and this has been an open question in Mexico and in the United States for years.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，多年来这在墨西哥和美国一直是个公开的问题。

sentences.en: Is it capacity?
sentences.zh: 是实力问题吗？

sentences.en: Is it ability?
sentences.zh: 是能力问题吗？

sentences.en: Or is it willingness, as you say?
sentences.zh: 还是像你说的意愿问题？

sentences.en: And it's kind of difficult to know because it hasn't been happening and it's hard to disentangle the reasons why.
sentences.zh: 这有点难以弄明白，因为它一直没有发生，而且很难理清其中的原因。

sentences.en: But at the time that I'm visiting this lab, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但在我参观这个实验室的时候，美国

sentences.en: is preparing to inaugurate Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 正准备为唐纳德·特朗普举行就职典礼。

sentences.en: And he pretty quickly makes it very clear that he thinks he knows why.
sentences.zh: 他很快就非常明确地表达了自己的看法，并自认为找到了原因。

sentences.en: I've informed Mexico and Canada that they will have to step up and stop the illegal aliens and illegal drugs from pouring into our country.
sentences.zh: 我已通知墨西哥和加拿大，他们必须加大力度，阻止非法移民和非法毒品涌入我国。

sentences.en: Have to stop.
sentences.zh: 必须阻止。

sentences.en: It's that Mexico just doesn't want to do enough.
sentences.zh: 问题在于墨西哥就是不愿付出足够的努力。

sentences.en: That there's not enough progress being made.
sentences.zh: 并没有取得足够的进展。

sentences.en: That the country is absolutely dominated by this drug.
sentences.zh: 这个国家完全被这种毒品所控制。

sentences.en: And he's saying the government absolutely needs to do more or there will be consequences.
sentences.zh: 他表示，政府绝对需要采取更多行动，否则将承担后果。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Trump's argument throughout the campaign and once he's elected is basically Mexico chooses this situation and it can do a heck of a lot more.
sentences.zh: 特朗普在整个竞选期间以及当选后的论调基本上都是，墨西哥选择了这种现状，其实它本可以做得多得多。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 一点没错。

sentences.en: And as soon as he finally takes office,
sentences.zh: 而就在他正式上任后不久，

sentences.en: I'm not happy with Mexico or I'm not happy with Mexico.
sentences.zh: 我对墨西哥很不满意，或者说我对墨西哥很不满。

sentences.en: He just starts lobbing attack after attack on Mexico.
sentences.zh: 他便开始接连不断地对墨西哥发起攻击。

sentences.en: And he's really turning the heat up.
sentences.zh: 局势确实被他彻底炒热了。

sentences.en: President Scheinbaum is a woman.
sentences.zh: 辛鲍姆总统是一位女性。

sentences.en: I like her very much.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢她。

sentences.en: We've had good relationships, but we have to stop fentanyl from coming in, whether I like somebody or not.
sentences.zh: 我们一直保持着良好的关系，但不管我喜不喜欢某个人，我们都必须阻止芬太尼流入。

sentences.en: There's this threat in the air about a potential for U.S.
sentences.zh: 空气中弥漫着一种威胁，即美国

sentences.en: military forces to do targeted strikes on drug labs and cartels in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 军方可能会对墨西哥的制毒实验室和贩毒集团进行定向打击。

sentences.en: Eventually, the administration officially designates the cartels as terrorist organizations.
sentences.zh: 最终，美国政府正式将这些贩毒集团列为恐怖组织。

sentences.en: And most importantly,
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，

sentences.en: I'll be putting the tariff of 25 percent on Canada and separately 25 percent on Mexico.
sentences.zh: 我将对加拿大加征25%的关税，同时对墨西哥单独加征25%的关税。

sentences.en: Trump says he's going to impose massive, devastating tariffs on Mexico unless they get this problem under control.
sentences.zh: 特朗普表示，除非墨西哥能控制住这个问题，否则他将对其实施大规模、毁灭性的关税制裁。

sentences.en: And I wonder, based on this lab you saw and based on all the reporting you have done, what you made of Trump's actions as they were unfurling
sentences.zh: 我想知道，根据你看到的这个实验室以及你所做的大量报道，你对特朗普这一系列眼花缭乱的动作有何看法，

sentences.en: and if you thought it stood any real chance of changing the fentanyl realities on the ground in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 你是否认为这真的有可能改变墨西哥国内芬太尼泛滥的现实。

sentences.en: I mean, honestly, Michael, I was deeply skeptical.
sentences.zh: 说实话，迈克尔，我深表怀疑。

sentences.en: I had been going to Sinaloa for months based on everything I'd seen.
sentences.zh: 根据我所看到的一切，我几个月来一直前往锡那罗亚。

sentences.en: This organization, this criminal group, was just so entrenched in so many aspects of daily life.
sentences.zh: 这个组织，这个犯罪集团，已经深深扎根于日常生活方方面面的许多环节中。

sentences.en: And it's really hard to imagine making a serious impact on a production operation that requires so little that can just be restarted from one moment to the next
sentences.zh: 很难想象，对于这样一个只需极少资源、随时可以死灰复燃的生产网络，

sentences.en: in a place that is dominated by one of the most powerful criminal organizations on the planet.
sentences.zh: 并且身处一个被全球最强大的犯罪集团之一所控制的地方，如何能对其产生实质性的冲击。

sentences.en: But even though I was really skeptical,
sentences.zh: 但尽管我非常怀疑，

sentences.en: I wanted to go back into a lab to see whether all of these threats, whether all of the pressure that Trump had put on Mexico had led to real changes,
sentences.zh: 我还是想再次探访实验室，看看特朗普对墨西哥施加的所有这些威胁和压力是否带来了真正的改变，

sentences.en: whether any of this actually made a difference.
sentences.zh: 看看这一切是否真的产生了影响。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wenna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写了《连连看》（Connections）这款游戏，这是《纽约时报》益智游戏中的一款。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖尔斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责创作《拼字蜂》（Spelling Bee）和《连字》（Letterboxd）游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的奇特现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时会看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像刚才你们听到声音的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 请访问 nytimes.com/games，今天就开始游玩吧。

sentences.en: So, Natalie, when you went back to Sinaloa to try to assess whether anything had changed post-Trump's inauguration, what did you find?
sentences.zh: 那么，娜塔莉，当你重返锡那罗亚去评估特朗普就职后情况是否发生变化时，你发现了什么？

sentences.en: It was really remarkable.
sentences.zh: 这真的非同寻常。

sentences.en: The dynamics, it seemed, had completely changed from the last time we were there.
sentences.zh: 这里的动态似乎与我们上次来时完全不同了。

sentences.en: I mean, this was still a very dangerous place.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这里依然是一个非常危险的地方。

sentences.en: There was a lot of violence.
sentences.zh: 暴力事件依然很多。

sentences.en: But when we started talking to our cartel contacts, they told us there was basically no production of fentanyl happening in the city.
sentences.zh: 但当我们开始与贩毒集团的线人交谈时，他们告诉我们，这个城市里基本上已经没有芬太尼在生产了。

sentences.en: It had totally plummeted.
sentences.zh: 产量已经彻底暴跌。

sentences.en: Fallen off a cliff.
sentences.zh: 呈断崖式下跌。

sentences.en: I mean, they acknowledged that production was happening elsewhere in the country.
sentences.zh: 当然，他们也承认该国其他地方仍在生产。

sentences.en: It's not like fentanyl stopped being made in Mexico writ large.
sentences.zh: 并不是说墨西哥全境彻底停止制造芬太尼了。

sentences.en: But here, things had slowed to a near halt.
sentences.zh: 但在这里，情况已经几乎陷入停滞。

sentences.en: We met the two cooks who had invited us into their labs.
sentences.zh: 我们见到了那两位曾邀请我们进入其实验室的厨师（制毒师）。

sentences.en: They said, no, we shut everything down.
sentences.zh: 他们说，不，我们把一切都关停了。

sentences.en: There is such an intense crackdown by the government right now, and we're under so much scrutiny and pressure that we're not cooking anything.
sentences.zh: 政府目前的打击力度太猛了，我们正受到如此严密的审视和压力，以至于我们什么都不敢做了。

sentences.en: We didn't meet them inside a lab.
sentences.zh: 我们并不是在实验室里见到他们的。

sentences.en: They met us at our hotel room, and they said, we're not doing anything right now.
sentences.zh: 他们在我们的酒店房间里与我们见面，并表示，我们现在什么都没干。

sentences.en: We're actually firing employees.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上在解雇员工。

sentences.en: We're saving money.
sentences.zh: 我们在省钱。

sentences.en: We're trying to sell our cars and other property to try to make up for lost income because nothing is going on here.
sentences.zh: 我们正试图卖掉汽车和其他财产来弥补收入损失，因为这里现在什么都没有。

sentences.en: There is no lab for you to visit this time around.
sentences.zh: 这一次你们没有什么实验室可参观了。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哈。

sentences.en: And we saw firsthand the crackdown that they were so afraid of.
sentences.zh: 我们亲眼目睹了让他们如此恐惧的严厉打击行动。

sentences.en: Spoke on it later.
sentences.zh: 后来也谈到了这一点。

sentences.en: At one point, we're driving down the street.
sentences.zh: 有一次，我们正开车在街上行驶。

sentences.en: Where?
sentences.zh: 在哪儿？

sentences.en: Where?
sentences.zh: 在哪儿？

sentences.en: And these police trucks pull up.
sentences.zh: 然后这些警车停了下来。

sentences.en: These guys just start spilling out of them, and they're scaling the walls of this house.
sentences.zh: 这些人从车里蜂拥而出，开始攀爬一所房子的围墙。

sentences.en: Suddenly, they're on the roof.
sentences.zh: 转眼间，他们就上了屋顶。

sentences.en: All right, we're literally watching a raid on a house go down.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们简直是在亲眼目睹一场针对民宅的突袭行动。

sentences.en: We just drove up on it.
sentences.zh: 我们正好开车碰上了。

sentences.en: There's a police car and, like, a kind of military-style tank-like car.
sentences.zh: 那里有一辆警车和一辆类似军用坦克的车辆。

sentences.en: It's very clear to us that something is going down.
sentences.zh: 我们非常清楚有大事要发生了。

sentences.en: There's officers just all along the street.
sentences.zh: 整条街上到处都是警察。

sentences.en: We're watching them arrest a guy, it looks like, or they're at least searching the guy.
sentences.zh: 我们看着他们逮捕了一个人，或者至少是在搜查那个人。

sentences.en: And this kind of scene was playing out all over the city.
sentences.zh: 这样的场景在整个城市里到处都在上演。

sentences.en: This is just, like, an area that we've been hanging out in this whole time, and, like, here is a raid looking for whatever, either a lab or a person or whatever.
sentences.zh: 这就像是我们一直以来闲逛的区域，然而这里却发生了一场搜查实验室、搜查某个人或搜寻其他目标的突袭行动。

sentences.en: While we were there, the Mexican government arrested two major players within the cartel.
sentences.zh: 在我们逗留期间，墨西哥政府逮捕了该贩毒集团的两名核心人物。

sentences.en: So there was a lot of activity.
sentences.zh: 所以当时有大量的行动。

sentences.en: At one point, we go to meet with a higher-level cartel member who, when we get to him, he said he had heard about the raid that we ran up on, and he is genuinely shaking.
sentences.zh: 有一次，我们去会见一位贩毒集团的高层成员，当我们见到他时，他说他听说了我们碰上的那场突袭行动，他真的在发抖。

sentences.en: His hands...
sentences.zh: 他的手……

sentences.en: Physically shaking.
sentences.zh: 身体在颤抖。

sentences.en: His hands are trembling in front of us.
sentences.zh: 他的双手在我们面前瑟瑟发抖。

sentences.en: And he said, the only option for me right now is survival.
sentences.zh: 他说，我眼下唯一的选择就是活下去。

sentences.en: No, we're not cooking.
sentences.zh: 不，我们没有在制毒。

sentences.en: No, we're not making fentanyl.
sentences.zh: 不，我们没有在制造芬太尼。

sentences.en: That is shut down right now.
sentences.zh: 目前已经全部停工了。

sentences.en: It may be temporary.
sentences.zh: 这可能是暂时的。

sentences.en: We are moving labs.
sentences.zh: 我们正在转移实验室。

sentences.en: We're doing this elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 我们在其他地方搞这个。

sentences.en: But right now, I am on lockdown here.
sentences.zh: 但现在，我在这里处于封锁状态。

sentences.en: I am not leaving my house.
sentences.zh: 我不会离开我的房子。

sentences.en: I have lookouts everywhere.
sentences.zh: 我到处都安排了眼线。

sentences.en: And I can't even be here.
sentences.zh: 我甚至都不能待在这里。

sentences.en: He cut the meeting short.
sentences.zh: 他缩短了会面时间。

sentences.en: He basically ran out.
sentences.zh: 他几乎是跑着离开的。

sentences.en: He was so scared.
sentences.zh: 他吓坏了。

sentences.en: And is this all because of Trump?
sentences.zh: 这一切都是因为特朗普吗？

sentences.en: Well, these guys that we're talking to are saying, look, the main thing that has changed from when you were here last
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们交谈的这些人说，你看，自从你上次来这里之后，发生的最大变化

sentences.en: is that Trump is in office and he's making all of these threats and the Mexican government is cracking down like never before.
sentences.zh: 就是特朗普上台了，他发出了所有这些威胁，而墨西哥政府正在进行空前严厉的打击。

sentences.en: Obviously, the Mexican authorities were on the streets before this.
sentences.zh: 显然，在此之前墨西哥执法部门也一直在街头巡逻。

sentences.en: It's not like they weren't doing anything, but the cartel members say they're feeling the heat at a much higher level.
sentences.zh: 并非他们什么都没做，但贩毒集团成员表示，他们感受到的压力达到了高得多的水平。

sentences.en: It very much looks like Trump has shocked the Mexican law enforcement system into action and in so doing seemed to expose that the Mexican government
sentences.zh: 这看起来很像是特朗普通过强力震撼迫使墨西哥执法系统采取了行动，并在此过程中似乎暴露出墨西哥政府

sentences.en: was capable of doing a lot more than it had been.
sentences.zh: 其实有能力做到比以往多得多的事情。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think that's what it looks like to a lot of people, a lot of regular Mexicans, a lot of cartel members,
sentences.zh: 是的，我想在许多人、许多普通墨西哥人、许多贩毒集团成员

sentences.en: and a lot of security experts who have been studying this for a long time.
sentences.zh: 以及许多长期研究这一问题的安全专家看来，情况确实如此。

sentences.en: Now, we have to keep in mind,
sentences.zh: 当然，我们必须记住，

sentences.en: Claudia Sheinbaum, the new president, had come into office about a month before Trump was elected and then eventually started making these threats.
sentences.zh: 新总统克劳迪娅·辛鲍姆在特朗普当选前大约一个月上台，随后开始发出这些威胁。

sentences.en: So she had signaled early on that she was more willing to take on the cartels head-on aggressively than her predecessor.
sentences.zh: 因此，她很早就表明，与前任相比，她更愿意正面且强硬地对付贩毒集团。

sentences.en: So we don't know how much of this might have happened without Trump anyway because she was willing to change the approach.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不知道，如果没有特朗普，由于她愿意改变方针，其中有多少事情原本也会发生。

sentences.en: But I think it's pretty clear that the amount of progress, arrests, raids, lab busts, the pace of these actions is something that we've not seen in recent history in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 但我认为很明显，进展、逮捕、突袭、捣毁实验室的数量以及这些行动的节奏，是墨西哥近代史上从未见过的。

sentences.en: One analyst told us we've seen in one month what we might have seen in years.
sentences.zh: 一位分析人士告诉我们，我们在一个月内看到的情况，可能相当于过去好几年的总和。

sentences.en: Of all the things Trump did, I'm curious which in your reporting stands out as ultimately being the most effective as we think about
sentences.zh: 在特朗普所做的一切事情中，我很好奇在我们思考墨西哥政府的行动究竟有多么强硬时，

sentences.en: just how aggressive Mexico's government has been.
sentences.zh: 你认为他在报道中哪一点最为突出、最终最为有效。

sentences.en: I'm going to guess it's the threat of tariffs, but I'm curious what you found.
sentences.zh: 我猜是关税威胁，但我很好奇你发现了什么。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, obviously the threat of military intervention in any way, even if it's just targeted strikes, is anathema in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，很显然，任何形式的军事干预威胁，哪怕只是定向打击，在墨西哥都是大忌。

sentences.en: But the threat of tariffs has long seemed much more credible.
sentences.zh: 但关税威胁长期以来显得要可信得多。

sentences.en: I have to say, of the two, I think the tariff threat is the one that really spurs the action because there's a deadline.
sentences.zh: 我必须说，在这两者中，我认为关税威胁才是真正促成行动的关键，因为有一个最后期限。

sentences.en: I mean, last month, Trump essentially gave the Mexican government 30 days to show results on security, to deliver him the progress he wanted to see on fentanyl.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，上个月，特朗普基本上给了墨西哥政府30天的期限，要求他们在安全问题上拿出成果，在芬太尼问题上取得他希望看到的进展。

sentences.en: And when there's a deadline, I mean, people hustle to meet that deadline, especially if, you know, on the other side of that is potential economic ruin.
sentences.zh: 当有了期限时，人们就会争分夺秒去赶在期限前完成任务，特别是如果你知道，期限的另一头可能是潜在的经济毁灭。

sentences.en: So I do think that was really motivating here.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实认为这在其中起到了巨大的激励作用。

sentences.en: I mean, what's fascinating about what you're saying is that it seems to confirm to a degree the Donald Trump thesis, which we've talked about a fair amount on this show
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你所说的话最令人着迷的地方在于，它在某种程度上似乎证实了唐纳德·特朗普的论点——我们在本节目中与一些同事

sentences.en: with some of our colleagues, that tariffs are a kind of everything, every issue tool, potentially.
sentences.zh: 曾多次讨论过这一点——即关税可能是一种“万能”的工具，适用于所有问题。

sentences.en: But what's tricky is the question of whether they're stronger as a threat or as a reality.
sentences.zh: 但棘手的问题在于，它们作为一种威胁还是作为既成事实，究竟哪一个更有力。

sentences.en: And as we're talking to you, the United States has made the threat of tariffs against Mexico a reality.
sentences.zh: 就在我们与你交谈之际，美国已经把针对墨西哥的关税威胁变成了现实。

sentences.en: We don't know how long it's going to last, but the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道这会持续多久，但美国

sentences.en: has put into place tariffs on Mexico.
sentences.zh: 已经对墨西哥实施了关税。

sentences.en: They could be rolled back in the coming hours or days.
sentences.zh: 这些关税可能会在未来几小时或几天内被取消。

sentences.en: But that makes me wonder if Trump is happy with what Mexico has done so far or thinks they can go a lot further when it comes to cracking down on fentanyl.
sentences.zh: 但这让我不禁好奇，特朗普是对墨西哥迄今为止的表现感到满意，还是认为他们在打击芬太尼方面还可以走得更远。

sentences.en: How do you see it and how do the leaders in Mexico see it?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么看的？墨西哥的领导人们又是怎么看的？

sentences.en: Well, the leaders in Mexico are just absolutely baffled about these tariffs.
sentences.zh: 嗯，墨西哥的领导人们对这些关税感到彻底的困惑。

sentences.en: They do not understand why they're getting punished after having delivered so many wins for Trump on security.
sentences.zh: 他们不明白为什么在为特朗普的安全诉求取得如此多的胜利之后，自己还要受到惩罚。

sentences.en: I mean, just days ago, the Mexican government handed over 29 drug lords that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是就在几天前，墨西哥政府还移交了29名美国政府一直希望引渡回美国起诉的毒枭。

sentences.en: government had been seeking to prosecute in the United States.
sentences.zh: 这些都是被移交给美国政府的重要人物。

sentences.en: These are major figures that had been given over to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这些都是被移交给美国政府的重要人物。

sentences.en: government.
sentences.zh: 政府。

sentences.en: And the Mexicans are saying, wait a minute, we've gone hard on these cartels.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥人会说，等一下，我们对这些贩毒集团已经够狠了。

sentences.en: We've given you these capos.
sentences.zh: 我们把这些头目都交给你们了。

sentences.en: What more could we possibly do?
sentences.zh: 我们还能做什么？

sentences.en: Well, what's the answer?
sentences.zh: 那么，答案是什么呢？

sentences.en: I mean, in theory, could they do more?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，从理论上讲，他们还能做更多吗？

sentences.en: Well, I mean, it's unclear.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，这还不清楚。

sentences.en: Nobody knows exactly what Trump wants.
sentences.zh: 没有人确切知道特朗普想要什么。

sentences.en: And it's a mystery whether there are actual benchmarks here or not, or whether the goalposts are just going to keep moving and moving and moving.
sentences.zh: 这里究竟有没有实际的基准，还是说目标会一直不断地移动下去，这是一个谜。

sentences.en: And there is some suggestion that they might reach a deal soon.
sentences.zh: 并且有迹象表明他们可能很快就会达成协议。

sentences.en: But the reality is that this pressure is horrific for Mexico.
sentences.zh: 但现实是，这种压力对墨西哥来说是极其可怕的。

sentences.en: Mexico is incredibly dependent on the U.S.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥在经济上高度依赖美国，

sentences.en: economy, on being able to access U.S.
sentences.zh: 依赖于能够进入美国

sentences.en: markets.
sentences.zh: 市场。

sentences.en: This could potentially push the country into a recession.
sentences.zh: 这可能会把这个国家推入经济衰退。

sentences.en: And so Claudia Sheinbaum and her government are going to do absolutely everything they can to get out from under this.
sentences.zh: 因此，克劳迪娅·希恩鲍姆和她的政府将竭尽全力摆脱这种困境。

sentences.en: And if that means more security gains, I think they're looking at how they can possibly do more because they feel like they have their foot completely on the gas at this point,
sentences.zh: 如果这意味着要取得更多安全成果，我想他们正在研究如何尽可能做到更多，因为他们觉得目前已经完全开足了马力，

sentences.en: and they still got hit with the tariffs.
sentences.zh: 但他们还是受到了关税的打击。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So in theory, Trump's approach, as it gets more and more punitive, it may keep exposing all the things that Mexico hasn't done,
sentences.zh: 所以在理论上，特朗普的方法越来越具有惩罚性，它可能会不断暴露出墨西哥多年来本可以做、

sentences.en: could have done, arguably should have done for years to crack down on fentanyl, but hasn't, or it could end up exposing the limits of what Mexico can do about fentanyl
sentences.zh: 本应该做却没有做来打击芬太尼的所有事情，或者它最终可能会暴露出墨西哥在芬太尼问题上所能做的事情的极限，

sentences.en: and the damage that the United States is willing to do to Mexico's economy in the pursuit of finding out just how much it can do about fentanyl.
sentences.zh: 以及美国为了弄清墨西哥在芬太尼问题上到底能做多少而愿意对墨西哥经济造成的损害。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, it remains to be seen.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，这还有待观察。

sentences.en: I mean, I told you that I was skeptical at the outset that this would have made a real difference, and I was proven wrong by the reporting.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我一开始就告诉你我对这能带来真正改变持怀疑态度，而报道证明我错了。

sentences.en: It very much has made a difference.
sentences.zh: 它确实带来了改变。

sentences.en: But we have no idea, actually, what the Mexican government may be able to accomplish as it tries to stave off these tariffs, get out from under them.
sentences.zh: 但我们实际上并不知道，当墨西哥政府试图避开这些关税、摆脱这些关税时，它到底能取得什么成就。

sentences.en: Keep in mind, the Mexican government has been busting labs across the country, but the most intense crackdown has been mainly concentrated in this one state,
sentences.zh: 请记住，墨西哥政府一直在全国各地打击实验室，但最激烈的打击主要集中在一个州，

sentences.en: Sinaloa.
sentences.zh: 锡那罗亚。

sentences.en: It's a really important state.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常重要的州。

sentences.en: It's a major hub of fentanyl production, but it's just one state.
sentences.zh: 它是芬太尼生产的一个主要中心，但这只是一个州。

sentences.en: This drug is made all over the country.
sentences.zh: 这种毒品在全国各地都有制造。

sentences.en: And, you know, if you imagine this crackdown spreading, it requires a lot of resource.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，如果你想象这种打击行动蔓延开来，它需要大量的资源。

sentences.en: It requires a lot of troops.
sentences.zh: 它需要大量的军队。

sentences.en: It requires a lot of intelligence.
sentences.zh: 它需要大量的情报。

sentences.en: And it requires a lot of willingness sustained over a really long period of time to make a difference.
sentences.zh: 并且它需要在极长的一段时间内保持高度的意愿才能发挥作用。

sentences.en: There is also huge demand for this drug in the United States that really hasn't been addressed.
sentences.zh: 美国对这种毒品也有着巨大的需求，而这实际上并未得到解决。

sentences.en: And so it is hard to imagine that even this push, even a sustained push, could entirely stamp out the production of this drug without a lot of other elements coming into play.
sentences.zh: 因此很难想象，如果没有许多其他因素发挥作用，即使是这种压力，甚至是持续的压力，也能彻底根除这种毒品的生产。

sentences.en: And I think we're all watching to see what those elements are.
sentences.zh: 我想我们都在观望这些因素究竟是什么。

sentences.en: Will Trump decide to address demand in the United States, the addiction that has driven so many people to this lethal substance?
sentences.zh: 特朗普会决定解决美国的毒品需求问题吗？正是这种瘾导致了那么多人走向这种致命物质？

sentences.en: Will Sheinbaum continue the pressure?
sentences.zh: 希恩鲍姆会继续施压吗？

sentences.en: And for how long can Trump really keep Mexico in this position of trying to satisfy his demands?
sentences.zh: 而且特朗普究竟能让墨西哥保持这种试图满足他要求的姿态多久？

sentences.en: Because if they reach a deal on tariffs, then what?
sentences.zh: 因为如果他们在关税问题上达成协议，接下来呢？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对吧。

sentences.en: Has the incentive for Mexico to pursue this crackdown gone away?
sentences.zh: 墨西哥继续进行这种打击行动的动力是不是就消失了？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对吧。

sentences.en: And are we looking at a period of potentially several years of these threats and uncertainty and upheaval?
sentences.zh: 我们是否正面临着可能长达数年的威胁、不确定性和动荡时期？

sentences.en: Or is this all just going to go away tomorrow if they reach a deal?
sentences.zh: 还是说只要他们达成协议，这一切明天就会烟消云散？

sentences.en: But no matter what happens, it does feel like the clear lesson from your reporting here.
sentences.zh: 但无论发生什么，这确实感觉像是你在这里的报道得出的清晰教训。

sentences.en: And it's a surprising one.
sentences.zh: 这是一个令人意外的教训。

sentences.en: And like you said, you were skeptical of it.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，你对此持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: I'll confess, I was a little skeptical of it myself.
sentences.zh: 我承认，我自己也曾对此感到有点怀疑。

sentences.en: Is that tariffs as a tool of forcing a government like Mexico to crack down on a very deadly drug is effective.
sentences.zh: 那就是关税作为迫使像墨西哥这样的政府打击一种致命毒品的工具是有效的。

sentences.en: I think what we've seen is that at least in this context, in this month and in this place, the tariffs worked, for now at leaSt.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们所看到的是，至少在这个语境下、在此时此地，关税起作用了，至少目前如此。

sentences.en: Well, Natalie, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，娜塔莉，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 非常感激。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Late on Thursday morning,
sentences.zh: 周四深夜，

sentences.en: President Trump said he was suspending tariffs on most imports from Mexico for the next month.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统表示，他将在接下来的一个月内暂停对绝大多数来自墨西哥的进口商品征收关税。

sentences.en: After a call with Mexico's president,
sentences.zh: 在与墨西哥总统通话后，

sentences.en: Trump said, quote,
sentences.zh: 特朗普表示，引述如下：

sentences.en: We are working hard together on the border, both in terms of stopping illegal aliens from entering the United States and likewise stopping fentanyl.
sentences.zh: 我们在边境上正紧密合作，既要阻止非法移民进入美国，也要阻止芬太尼。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, the Supreme Court rejected President Trump's effort to freeze $2 billion in foreign aid owed to government contractors.
sentences.zh: 周三，最高法院驳回了特朗普总统冻结欠政府承包商的20亿美元外国援助的努力。

sentences.en: It was a major blow to Trump's efforts to circumvent Congress in his pursuit of cost-cutting.
sentences.zh: 这对特朗普在削减成本的过程中试图绕过国会的努力是一个重大打击。

sentences.en: The 5-4 rule, in which Chief Justice John Roberts and Justice Amy Coney Barrett sided with the court's liberal justices,
sentences.zh: 这项5比4的裁决中，首席大法官约翰·罗伯茨和大法官艾米·科尼·巴雷特站在了法院自由派大法官一边，

sentences.en: suggested that Trump's plans to remake the federal government will face skepticism from the high court.
sentences.zh: 这表明特朗普重塑联邦政府的计划将面临来自最高法院的质疑。

sentences.en: Mayor Johnson, is Denver a sanctuary city?
sentences.zh: 约翰逊市长，丹佛是庇护城市吗？

sentences.en: Folks use that term differently.
sentences.zh: 大家对这个词的理解各不相同。

sentences.en: I can tell you what Denver does.
sentences.zh: 我可以告诉你丹佛是怎么做的。

sentences.en: We do not—
sentences.zh: 我们不——

sentences.en: Okay, I take that as a yes.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我把这当作是“是”。

sentences.en: Mayor Johnson, no, yes or no?
sentences.zh: 约翰逊市长，不是，是还是不是？

sentences.en: I take that as a yes.
sentences.zh: 我把这当作是“是”。

sentences.en: During a contentious hearing,
sentences.zh: 在一次充满争议的听证会上，

sentences.en: House Republicans accused the Democratic mayors of New York, Denver, Boston, and Chicago of making their cities less safe by harboring criminal immigrants
sentences.zh: 众议院共和党人指责纽约、丹佛、波士顿和芝加哥的民主党籍市长通过庇护犯罪移民，

sentences.en: and refusing to fully cooperate with the president's efforts to crack down on illegal immigration.
sentences.zh: 并且拒绝全力配合总统打击非法移民的努力，导致他们的城市变得不那么安全。

sentences.en: In response, the mayors defended their policies, said that they were following federal immigration law, and told House Republicans that Congress itself
sentences.zh: 作为回应，市长们为他们的政策进行了辩护，称他们一直在遵守联邦移民法，并告诉众议院共和党人，国会本身

sentences.en: had the power to make their cities safer, but so far had failed to do so.
sentences.zh: 就有权力让他们的城市变得更安全，但到目前为止却没有这样做。

sentences.en: If you wanted to make us safe,
sentences.zh: 如果你想让我们安全，

sentences.en: pass gun reforms, stop cutting Medicaid, stop cutting cancer research, stop cutting funds for veterans.
sentences.zh: 那就通过枪支改革，停止削减医疗补助，停止削减癌症研究，停止削减退伍军人资金。

sentences.en: That is what will make our city safe.
sentences.zh: 那才是能让我们的城市安全的方法。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由凯特琳·奥基夫、

sentences.zh: 克莱尔·特内斯凯特和卡洛斯·普里埃托制作。

sentences.en: With help from Nina Feldman.
sentences.zh: 尼娜·费尔德曼提供了协助。

sentences.zh: 节目由丽莎·乔和莱克斯·迪奥剪辑。

sentences.zh: 包含丹·鲍威尔和帕特·麦克库斯克的原创音乐。

sentences.zh: 由艾丽莎·莫克斯利进行混音工程。

sentences.zh: 我们的主题曲由仙境乐队的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰兹伯格创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《今日早报》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了群自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱、有时令人惊心动魄的争斗之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《都市》最新一期节目中，我和萨拉·科尼格将带您了解那些试图维持影响力却最终失控的人的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.zh: 您可以在任何收听播客的地方收听。
